reason: We already run on Bitrix24 and everyone knows it, even if it is heavy. Moving a 20-person sales team to a new CRM and no help with moving the data is a lot of pain for me.
objection: No migration. All my deals and client history are in Bitrix24, and I am not re-entering them by hand or risking my team's work for a CRM I have never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: Free done-for-you import from Bitrix24 and a trial I can run alongside it with a few of my managers, with Telegram chats landing in the deal card.
